result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, matching the other per-rep and purchase-order reports.

**Change:** `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 6514) adds `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the inner count. It uses the same filter as the quarterly and weekday PO reports. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are excluded.

**Test:** I added `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` to `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`. It reproduces your example: Anna gets 2 and Bob gets 1. I also gave the test helper a status overload.

**Verification:** `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` (4 tests) and `DemoScenarioTest` pass offline. I did not commit.
